title: Nakayama in the graded setting: generation modulo the positive-degree part
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four graded forms of Nakayama's lemma: vanishing from S_+M = M for a finite graded module, the submodule version with N + S_+N', surjectivity detected modulo S_+M, and generation by elements generating the quotient by S_+M (statement lines 13466-13478). The proof does not repeat an argument four times: it settles the first assertion by choosing a homogeneous generator of minimal degree, which must vanish because of S_+M = M, and then derives the other three by applying the earlier parts to a quotient, to a pair of submodules, and to a shifted direct sum (proof lines 13480-13489). Deciding which earlier part each later assertion follows from is the content, and the author records each reduction in one clause. H2.
